assertions_note: Every assertion is verified programmatically by scripts/run_eval.py -- no eyeballing. Structural checks come from wechat_validate.py; the eval-specific ones (code_lines_preserved, formula_rendered_as_png, cjk_spacing_applied, ...) are implemented in run_eval.py as pure functions over the rendered fragment.

evals.name: tutorial-with-code
evals.prompt: 帮我把这篇 Markdown 教程排版成公众号文章：evals/cases/tutorial_with_code.md
evals.expected_output: 一篇可直接粘贴的公众号 HTML：代码块保留每一行、三个 callout 渲染成带边框的方框、表格带表头底色、无违规标签。

evals.name: formulas-and-tables
evals.prompt: 这篇有公式的文章要发公众号，帮我转成公众号格式：evals/cases/formulas_and_tables.md
evals.expected_output: 4 个公式全部渲染成 base64 PNG（不是 SVG、不是原始 $..$ 文本），目录自动生成，表格与重点框样式正确。

evals.name: messy-word-export
evals.prompt: 这是从 Word 粘出来的 HTML，直接发公众号很难看，帮我整理一下：evals/cases/messy_export.md
evals.expected_output: script/style/div 被移除，h1 降级为 h2，h4 归并为 h3，中英文之间补空格，半角标点规范化，远程图片被标记出来。
